'''Supeno Surija''' (born 1961; [[Medan|Medan, Indonesia]]) is an Indonesian writer, scientist, inventor and economic and environmental professional.

== Background ==
Surija earned master's and Ph.D. degrees and is a member of the [[American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Aplikasi CHIPS Ampuh Tanggulangi Jamur Ganoderma |url=https://analisadaily.com/berita/arsip/2016/7/21/251407/aplikasi-chips-ampuh-tanggulangi-jamur-ganoderma/ |work=Analisadaily.com |language=en}}</ref> In 2000, Surija became an active environmental activist and pioneer of Zero Burning in many plantations in Indonesia. In 2008, he established [[Buah Nabar]] Conservation in [[Sibolangit]], [[North Sumatra]], [[Indonesia]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Buah Nabar Conservation - Lost world & hidden valley|url=https://buahnabarconservation.org/|access-date=2021-03-21|website=buahnabarconservation.org}}</ref> Surija had completed CPD ([[Professional development|Continuing Professional Development]]) from distinguished universities, namely: RNA-seq data analysis from [[Harvard University]], Antimicrobial Stewardship from Stanford University and [[University of Dundee]], Developing New Drugs from Texas University, Extremes Microbes from [[Kyoto University]], Astrophysics from [[Australian National University]], Astrobiology from the [[University of Copenhagen]], Energy Development from [[University of Liverpool]] and Monitoring Climate from Space from [[European Space Agency]].

==Biotechnology==
Surija began his career in biology since he was in senior high school.<ref>{{cite news |title=Paralyze the Palm "Specter" Ganoderma |url=https://medanbisnisdaily.com/news/read/2016/08/22/252701/melumpuhkan_ganoderma_sang_momok_sawit/ |work=medanbisnisdaily.com}}</ref>

In 1994, he began his research on [[Dioxins and dioxin-like compounds|Dioxin]]-Free in the prevention of [[cancer]], [[diabetes]], [[infertility]], and [[DNA]] damage by implementing the Dioxin-Free system for the production, packaging, distribution, and consumption processes. As he continued his research, he successfully completed his research and invention which was written in the book ''Dioxin-Free System''. This invention has received many world awards, including an award from MURI (Indonesia World Records Museum) as the first dioxin-free system in the world.<ref>{{Cite book|last=Sarwono|first=Aylawati|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=fH1cDwAAQBAJ&q=Supeno+Surija+dioxin+free&pg=PA64|title=Rekor MURI|date=2013-02-13|publisher=Elex Media Komputindo|isbn=978-602-04-0397-7|language=id}}</ref>

In 1998, he started his research on agriculture and organic palm plantation. Through the root analysis and nanoparticle implementation, he successfully produced more efficient organic fertilizers at a lower cost and increased production significantly, unlike the failure of the previous generation of organic fertilizers for perennials (especially oil palm).<ref name="Surija & Bastian 2020">{{cite journal |last1=Surija |first1=Supeno |last2=Bastian |first2=Roderick |title=The Effectiviness of Organic Method for Increasing the Productivity of Oil Palm That Is Infected by Ganoderma |journal=Journal of Agricultural Science |date=15 April 2020 |volume=12 |issue=5 |pages=180 |doi=10.5539/jas.v12n5p180 |doi-access=free |s2cid=216184040 }}</ref>

In 2008, he established PT. [[Propadu Konair Tarahubun]], a subsidiary of Plantation Key Technology Group which is the acronym for Proyek Terpadu Konservasi Air, Tanah, Udara, Hutan, dan Perkebunan (Integrated Project for Water, Earth, Air, Forests Conservation, and Plantations) as plantation professional and producer of organic [[fertilizer]]s, [[biopesticide]]s, [[bioherbicide]]s.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Hadapi Ketidakpastian Harga Sawit, Teknologi PKT Solusinya|url=https://www.agricom.id/news/122/hadapi-ketidakpastian-harga-sawit--teknologi-pkt-solusinya}}</ref><ref name="Surija & Bastian 2020"/> The implementation of nanotechnology is the foundation of the success of PT Propadu Konair Tarahubun (Plantation Key Technology/ PKT) as the pioneer of organic oil palm plant and CPO around the world and in Indonesia.{{citation needed|date=November 2021}}

He is the first person in the world to invent a vaccine for Ganoderma disease in [[palm oil|oil palm]] plantations.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2016-04-17|title=Aplikasi CHIPS Mencegah Jamur Ganoderma Terhadap Lahan Perkebunan Sawit - Waspada Online {{!}} Pusat Berita dan Informasi Medan Sumut Aceh|url=https://waspada.co.id/2016/04/aplikasi-chips-mencegah-jamur-ganoderma-terhadap-lahan-perkebunan-sawit/|access-date=2021-03-20|language=id-ID}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{cite web |title=Penemu Vaksin Ganoderma untuk Menanggulangi Penyakit Busuk pada Pangkal Batang Sawit |trans-title=Inventor of Ganoderma Vaccine to Combat Diseases at the Base of Palm Stem |language=Indonesian |url=https://muri.org/Website/Rekor_detail/penemu_vaksin_ganoderma_untuk_menanggulangi_penyakit_busuk_pada_pangkal_batang_sawit |work=Museum Rekor - Dunia Indonesia }}</ref>

PKT is also the only company recognized by many parties for its success in preventing and handling the basal stem rot disease ''[[Ganoderma]]'' in oil palm plantations.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Ekonomi|first=Warta|title=Lahan Perkebunan Sawit di Sumut Gunakan Aplikasi CHIPS|url=https://www.wartaekonomi.co.id/read97598/lahan-perkebunan-sawit-di-sumut-gunakan-aplikasi-chips|access-date=2021-03-20|website=Warta Ekonomi|language=id}}</ref>

==Awards==
* 1996 – IBC Award, 2000 Outstanding People of the 20th Century, Various Research, Cambridge, England.<ref>{{Cite book|last=Tyler|first=Sean|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=V627OQAACAAJ|title=2000 Outstanding People of the 20th Century|date=1998|publisher=Melrose Press, Limited|isbn=978-0-948875-13-7|language=en}}</ref>
* 1997 – World Who's Who, Marquis, USA<ref>[https://cgi.marquiswhoswho.com/OnDemand/Default.aspx?last_name=surija&first_name=supeno For excellent effort and contribution to the world]</ref>
* 1998 – IBC Award, 20th Century Award for Achievement, Various Research, Cambridge, England.{{citation needed|date=November 2021}}
* 2000 – World Who's Who in Finance Industry, Marquis, USA.<ref>[https://cgi.marquiswhoswho.com/OnDemand/Default.aspx?last_name=surija&first_name=supeno The World Who’s Who in Finance Industry]</ref>
* 2005 – IBC Award, International Professional of the year 2005, Dioxin-Free® System Invention, Cambridge, England.{{citation needed|date=November 2021}}
* 2008 – “Dioxin-Free System” for the preservation of the environment for the invention and contribution of dioxin-free to the world from Indonesia World Records Museum (MURI).<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.muri.org/muri/rekor/11-iptek/3543-penemu-sistem-dioxin-free-untuk-pelestarian-lingkungan-hidup |title="Dioxin-Free System" for the preservation of the environment for the invention and contribution of dioxin-free to the world from Indonesia World Records Museum |access-date=2016-04-25 |archive-date=2016-04-23 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160423102310/http://www.muri.org/muri/rekor/11-iptek/3543-penemu-sistem-dioxin-free-untuk-pelestarian-lingkungan-hidup |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Solusi Pengendalian Ganoderma, PT Propadu Konair Punya Formula |url=https://www.bintangbisnis.com/2016/11/solusi-pengendalian-ganoderma-propadukonair-formula.html |work=Bintang Bisnis }}</ref>
*2016 – MURI award for Ganoderma Vaccine for basal stem rot disease.<ref name=":0" />
